finalText:
**Found it: `engine.js` was rounding to cents twice.**

After each coupon it rounded the running total to 2 decimals, then rounded again after converting to the order's currency. That double rounding threw off the last cent whenever a percent coupon left a fractional cent that got locked in too early — worst with non-USD currencies, since the rate multiply then amplified the error.

Fix: only round once, after the currency conversion, matching how carts are supposed to be priced.

All 40 pricing-matrix tests pass now, 96ms. Not committed yet.
